newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia data backs economic upturn-Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia data backs economic upturn-Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday economic figures released earlier in the day were consistent with expectations for an economic upturn.

"What that (the data) shows is it shows that there is a growing and strengthening in the economy, which is consistent with the government's expectations that the economy will pick up over the course of 1997 and 1998," Costello told parliament.
